comment: The lanes this harness dispatches, and the only place their data lives.
Read by bin/project-spaces.sh (lane_config_load) for bin/hw, bin/brain,
the invokers and shell/hw-restore-env.zsh. Why each value is what it is
stays in the code comment beside its reader; this file carries values.
Paths: a leading ~ is $HOME. {brain} is the brain root, {work} the
top-level `work` below, {checkout} the lane's checkout (after its
checkout_var override), {lane} the lane name, {task} the task name.
Order: `lanes` is the order hw names lanes in (its messages, `hw reports`).
`survey_order` is the order surveys walk them (`hw reap`, `hw worktrees`,
the invoker roots); a lane missing from it is walked last, in `lanes` order.
`build` names the file, relative to this one, that hw sources to build a
task's worktree for that lane (lanes/<lane>.sh). A lane with a worktree and
no `build` gets a complete dry run and a refusal to launch.

deps.line: none — the harness is shell, Python and tests; nothing in this lane installs

db.line: none — brain is prose, shell and tests; there is nothing to provision
